history.caption: A 180-day review period leaves a critical capital cost variable completely unpriced for planners buying reshoring machinery.
history.title: Unpriced-Machine-Duty-Assembly

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly resting on a weathered concrete plant floor. Extreme asymmetrical layout with generous negative space. An industrial robotic arm joint and a precision brushed steel housing featuring an unlatched inspection cover that exposes a deliberately empty modular bay. Hard clean edges on weathered concrete, safety yellow accents against concrete grey and slate grey. One sharp directional light from the top left throwing a long cast shadow across the matte muted palette. Recognisable engineered parts, no bare geometry, no molded or printed lettering.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, typography, watermarks, UI elements, human face, people
rationale: The story is about a single missing variable—an unpriced duty rate—in a structural calculation. Component assembly perfectly captures this by depicting a physical mechanism with a deliberately empty bay, representing the unresolved capital line.
cue: the one input with no rate
subject: an industrial robotic arm joint assembly with an empty modular bay
core_thesis: The tariff duty on reshoring machinery has been deferred for 180 days rather than settled, leaving the capital cost line in total cost models completely unpriced.
core_conflict: Capital planning requirement vs. unresolved regulatory uncertainty
composition: extreme asymmetrical layout with generous negative space

review.depicts: A yellow industrial robotic arm base with a silver metal box attached, featuring an open, empty compartment, casting a long shadow on a concrete floor.
review.reason: The image shows a robotic arm component with an empty bay, which aligns with the article's focus on unpriced machine duties and missing capital inputs.
